title: The Log Is the Agent
limitations: Vendor-origin architectural argument and position paper by the founder of Omnara (an open-source agent command center), also delivered as an AI Engineer World's Fair keynote. Proposes treating append-only event logs as the persistent definition of an agent rather than models or runtime infrastructure. Retaining, redacting, and replaying extensive agent telemetry creates substantial data-governance, storage, and privacy overhead in enterprise settings.
